findings.description: The frozen linear view compresses a bidirectional Field/Observation relation. Future implementation must keep evidence ingress (Reality -> Observation/Evidence -> Field reduction) distinct from Field-guided observation feedback.

Intent and Causal Reasoning participate through typed context and candidate dependencies. Diagram ordering must not be interpreted as unconditional ownership transfer or a fixed Runtime call sequence.

Emotional and short-term contextual carryover already remain source-owned and temporally governed. Future implementation contracts should keep reset triggers explicit and must not treat a physical Field switch as an automatic mental-state reset.
